title: Fumadocs Folder Metadata
description: Schema for meta.json files in Fumadocs content folders.

title.description: Custom display name for the folder or sidebar tab.

description.description: Optional description for the folder or tab.

icon.description: Icon name for the folder/tab (requires icon handler).

pages.description: Order and structure of child pages/folders. Supports special entries: '...', '---Separator---', and '[Text](url)'.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the folder is expanded by default in the sidebar.

root.description: Marks this folder as a root for sidebar tabs.
